text: Mimolette is a washed-curd pressed cheese coloured with annatto and shaped into a ball; during a long cave ripening the rind is colonised by cheese mites and regularly brushed and turned, giving a dry, hard, pitted crust. Long ageing concentrates its aroma and hardens the paste.

steps.note: Annatto is added at up to 0.35 mL per litre, for the orange colour.
The cheese is pressed into a sphere flattened at the poles, weighing 2–4 kg.
The cheese is put into saturated brine.
The cheese is turned and brushed; it ripens 13 months or more if vieille, 18 if extra-vieille.
